name: Character IP-Adapter + ControlNet (identity + pose lock)
description: Full golden-rule pipeline for THE FOUR SEASONS: IP-Adapter locks face/art style to a base-ai reference, Canny ControlNet locks pose/body proportions to a second reference, optional pixel-art LoRA. SD1.5 only: ckpt 'Counterfeit-V3.0_fix_fp16.safetensors' for anime/pixel work, 'dreamshaper_8.safetensors' for the semi-realistic 3D-render look of the confirmed design sheets. Sampler euler_ancestral/karras, ControlNet end_percent 0.85, canny thresholds 100/200. Required overrides: prompt, ckpt, character_ref, pose_ref, ip_weight, cn_strength, lora_strength, filename_prefix (plus negative_prompt in practice - if omitted it falls back to the weak global default 'text, watermark'). Set lora_strength 0.0 for non-pixel-art output.

defaults.negative_prompt: worst quality, low quality, bad anatomy, bad hands, missing limbs, extra limbs, cropped, text, watermark, signature, jpeg artifacts, blurry
